rows.difference_from_nearest: SUSCA changes scalar marginal values/support floors inside shared capacity; SCCATF introduces pairwise covariance cross-terms between allocation choices, so the objective is no longer separable across regions.
external_prior_art: Covariance-aware optimal design/allocation is established; 2026 covariance-aware compromise allocation explicitly puts covariance interactions into a constrained allocation objective.
rows.mechanism_removing_comparator: same CATF allocation with covariance coupling removed from the objective
rows.new_failure_mode: CATF allocates with additive local losses while off-diagonal support covariance makes one region choice change the risk cost of another region choice.
rows.non_additive_interaction: SACPS covariance enters CATF as an off-diagonal quadratic cross-term over allocation exposures; strong coupling changes the joint allocation while zero/low coupling collapses to CATF.

rows.difference_from_nearest: BOSARO changes uncertainty-set geometry from support erosion; BMCAPL changes the policy action/update feasible set from decision-tipping distance.
external_prior_art: Uncertainty-aware/adaptive trust-region policy optimization already adapts permitted policy movement to estimation uncertainty.
rows.mechanism_removing_comparator: same CAPL shell with fixed base turnover independent of BMDT tipping distance
rows.new_failure_mode: A policy learner may satisfy static action constraints yet make an update whose allowed turnover is too large relative to the nearest belief change that flips the downstream decision.
rows.non_additive_interaction: BMDT decision-tipping distance continuously contracts CAPL maximum-turnover feasibility before policy optimization; it changes the feasible action set, not only a report or binary gate.

rows.difference_from_nearest: PCFDLW changes the admissible candidate set using closure/fidelity certificates; CDTDLEW keeps candidates but changes the decision-loss objective across a channel-tipping ambiguity set.
external_prior_art: Blackwell informativeness under ambiguous experiments and maxmin/Wald comparisons over sets of experiments are established.
rows.mechanism_removing_comparator: ordinary DLEW selection at the nominal channel regime only
rows.new_failure_mode: DLEW can pick the lowest-regret model at one nominal channel even when a nearby channel-informativeness regime reverses that ranking.
rows.non_additive_interaction: CDTS defines the protected ambiguity/regime set and DLEW changes its selection objective to minimax decision regret over that set.

rows.difference_from_nearest: QDRA allocates a declared resolution budget by decision-boundary value; ATSCWC changes the sequential measurement policy itself and thereby the stochastic stream seen by an online calibration-width controller.
external_prior_art: Yang & Zhang (2026), Conformalized Rate-Adaptive Sensing, jointly adapts sensing/acquisition rate and conformal calibration/coverage.
rows.mechanism_removing_comparator: same CWC and same query budget with ActiveThresholdSensing selection replaced by a frozen evenly-spaced query schedule
rows.new_failure_mode: A calibration controller receives a needlessly noisy/wide posterior stream when measurement locations are frozen even though the same measurement budget can be targeted adaptively.
rows.non_additive_interaction: Active sensing changes the data-generating measurement locations that create the center/scale stream subsequently controlled for coverage; the acquisition policy and calibration state form a closed loop.

rows.difference_from_nearest: ISTAICC lets information acquisition itself move a participation/search equilibrium and adds continuation value; CBSCG uses an endogenous routing equilibrium to create the action surface whose latent state determines whether information is worth buying.
external_prior_art: Value of information in Bayesian routing/congestion games with endogenous route response is established; the R386 composition is an internal product architecture, not a new information-economics theorem.
rows.mechanism_removing_comparator: same Wardrop strategic-response project choice using midpoint demand with the CBIA information-acquisition step removed
rows.new_failure_mode: Midpoint-demand infrastructure choice can be wrong when latent demand changes the strategic routing equilibrium and therefore flips the optimal capacity intervention.
rows.non_additive_interaction: Strategic-response equilibrium creates an action boundary in latent demand; CBIA acquires information only when the calibrated demand shell spans different equilibrium-optimal interventions and prices it by avoided decision regret.

rows.difference_from_nearest: Different economic shell and action direction, but the deep operator is the same current information action -> endogenous future information equilibrium -> continuation-value correction already represented by V2P035.
external_prior_art: Bayesian persuasion with costly/endogenous information acquisition is established; 2026 supply-chain work explicitly studies disclosure crowding out external learning.
rows.mechanism_removing_comparator: same persuasion and information-production kernels with the disclosure-to-future-production coupling removed
rows.new_failure_mode: Aggressive disclosure can improve current persuasion payoff while destroying future information-producer entry.
rows.non_additive_interaction: Disclosure changes the future information-production equilibrium and therefore current policy value.

rows.difference_from_nearest: Executable deeper timing example, but it remains the same boundary/tipping signal -> testing-wealth release/timing family already represented by V2P015.
external_prior_art: Adaptive online testing/alpha-wealth allocation is established; no new FDR theorem is claimed.
rows.mechanism_removing_comparator: same p-value stream, alpha budget, and TestingWealthController with FPTE coupling removed
rows.new_failure_mode: A fixed testing-wealth time profile can miss early signals when a declared failure path is close to tipping.
rows.non_additive_interaction: Failure-tipping proximity changes the temporal alpha-wealth profile.

rows.difference_from_nearest: STHA uses a tipping signal to abstain from a holdout audit; MTCWC uses a tipping signal to alter the internal state-transition/reset law of a continuing feedback controller.
external_prior_art: Adaptive conformal methods with structural-break/change-point detection and calibration-window reset are established; recent 2026 online conformal work also targets faster shift adaptation.
rows.mechanism_removing_comparator: same residual stream and CWC gains with tipping signal/state reset removed
rows.new_failure_mode: A feedback calibration controller adapts too slowly after an externally observable mechanism/stress parameter crosses a certificate-breaking surface.
rows.non_additive_interaction: MCST tipping changes the controller state transition by resetting its learned width state; this is neither a pre-gate nor a changed measurement stream.

rows.difference_from_nearest: Mechanically interesting, but the exact TWMR->CWC pair is absent from the raw R386 native inferred-edge queue; prior rank-10 language referred to diversity reconstruction, not raw native rank.
external_prior_art: Model-reduction error is routinely propagated as epistemic uncertainty in reduced-order/multiscale models.
rows.mechanism_removing_comparator: same residual stream and CWC with the TWMR structural-error reserve removed
rows.new_failure_mode: Structural model-reduction error can contaminate stochastic coverage-feedback state if both are learned as one residual width.
rows.non_additive_interaction: TWMR structural reserve is separated from CWC stochastic feedback state.

rows.difference_from_nearest: Cross-domain safety realization of the same action-boundary information-acquisition operator already established by V2P043.
external_prior_art: Preserved as cross-domain evidence, not a new family.
rows.mechanism_removing_comparator: same CCVC using prior-midpoint state with information acquisition removed
rows.new_failure_mode: Prior-midpoint safety control can violate viability when latent state uncertainty spans different CCVC-filtered safe actions.
rows.non_additive_interaction: CBIA buys the state measurement only when the calibrated shell spans different viability-filtered controls.

rules: native/raw queue or explicit canonical productization authority required for product-overlay promotion
executable suite does not imply distinct family
new failure + non-additive interaction + nearest-family comparison + removal control required
external prior art limits novelty claims but does not erase an internally distinct executable product architecture
telemetry calibrates test channels; it is not deployment evidence
